result.summary: No critical or major visual breakage is apparent. The main intentionally scrollable/clipped areas were excluded per instructions. Remaining findings are minor accessibility/readability concerns rather than broken layout.

issues.description: Secondary gray text such as delivery fees and restaurant metadata is relatively low-contrast against the white background.
issues.suggestion: Darken secondary text or increase font weight/size to meet WCAG contrast guidance.

issues.description: Favorite heart icons on cards are small and appear to have no visible label, which may make them harder to tap and less clear for assistive technologies.
issues.suggestion: Increase touch target size to at least 44x44pt and provide an accessible label such as 'Save restaurant'.
